$comment: Motion packs. A book names one or more in book.json "motion": ["fade","draw"]; build injects motion.css and motion.js, and the page runs on screen only. Every pack animates transform and opacity — never width, height, margin or padding — so the sheet's measured box never moves and check.mjs still reads 0 mm. All motion is frozen at its first frame under @media print and prefers-reduced-motion, so paper, PDF and EPUB get the still pose. A book that names no pack takes the untouched build path and produces byte-identical output.

fade.label: Fade in
fade.note: each page and band settles in as it enters view. The gentlest pack; safe on any book.

draw.label: Draw on
draw.note: SVG strokes draw themselves once the diagram is in view. For mechanism diagrams.

isometric.label: Isometric
isometric.note: cards and diagrams tilt into a soft 3D pose and lift on hover. For stacks, systems and architecture.

stick.label: Stick cast
stick.note: original stick figures walk, wave and gesture in a loop. For stories and explainers with a reader in them.

scroll.label: Scroll reveal
scroll.note: the explainer lines and the action box rise in one after another as the reader scrolls. For long explanatory pages.
